heading: Contractors’ Disciplinary Board Panel
context:
Authorized Persons, Registered Structural Engineers, Registered Geotechnical
Engineers, Registered Inspectors and Registered
Contractors
content:
11A.
Contractors’ Disciplinary Board Panel
(1)
There shall be a Registered Contractors’ Disciplinary Board Panel, which shall be appointed by the Chief Executive.
(Amended 62 of 2000 s. 3)
(2)
(Repealed 54 of 1996 s. 12)
(3)
The members of the Registered Contractors’ Disciplinary Board Panel shall hold office for 3 years but shall be eligible for reappointment.
(Added 52 of 1974 s. 8)
